When and why did you start training for fighting? I did karate from 5-17 then started kickboxing when I was 18. That eventually turned into BJJ, then MMA. Martial Arts has always been a passion of mine. It’s a way of discipline and respect. 

Training: Morning begins with S&C and by the afternoon I'm back training more specific MMA-related skills. 

What ranks and titles have you held? I am a black belt in Jhoon-Rhee Taekwondo. I'm currently a blue belt in BJJ. As an amateur fighter I was a four-time world kickboxing champ & three-time amateur MMA champion, eventually earning the #1 amateur spot before turning pro. 

Do you have any heroes? My mother - for her strength and never ending love. 

What does it mean for you to fight in the UFC? A childhood dream come true. 

Did you go to college and if so what degree did you earn? I graduated at 20 years old in 2010 with a Bachelor of Arts, double majoring in Criminal Justice and Sociology. 

What was your job before you started fighting? I worked in customer care for a cruise line. 

Favorite grappling technique: Ground-and-Pound 

Favorite Striking technique: Punches in bunches

Our gym is traditionally known for being a hardcore MMA gym so I got sucked into MMA quite early. We agreed with my coach that first we are going to build a solid ground game, then start concentrating on MMA and stand-up.

What ranks and titles have you held? I´m a Finnish amateur champion in MMA and a Finnish champion in ADCC.

Do you have any heroes? I´m an old ice hockey player too, so I must say Finnish ice hockey legend Teemu Selänne.

What does it mean for you to fight in the UFC? It used to be a dream, and then it became a goal and now it´s a great reality. Now we have to set higher goals. The UFC is the way to make those goals happen.

Did you go to college and if so what degree did you earn? No

What was your job before you started fighting? I was a machinery technician

qna.value:
When and why did you start training for fighting? I started wrestling when I was 9, thanks to my uncle. Then, in 2018, I began training in MMA, boxing, kickboxing, and jiu-jitsu. Watching my first UFC fight at 9 made me realize I wanted to be a fighter.

What professional titles have you held? I currently hold the A1 Combat Flyweight title.

Any accomplishments in amateur combat sports? As an amateur, I was a California state champion, 559 Fights champion, Bay Area Combat champion, SF Combat champion, and Panda Cup champion.

Any belts/ranks in grappling disciplines? I was recently promoted to brown belt in jiu-jitsu.

What has been your toughest fight to date and why? My toughest fight was against Keanu Moyer. I was losing the fight up until I finished him with a body shot. It forced me to dig deep and find a way to win.

Who is your favorite fighter and why? Demetrious Johnson is my favorite because of his masterful performances, his clean striking, movement, grappling, and how he ties everything together.

What was your job before you started fighting? I worked as a mix room operator for Toray Advanced Composites before I started fighting.

Origin of nickname: My coach gave me the nickname after my 2nd amateur fight. He looked at me and said, “Wrong Turn,” meaning when someone takes a fight with me, they took a wrong turn. It just stuck from there.

Personal Life / Background: I would never have started training or fighting if it wasn’t for my Uncle Johnny. He’s the reason I fell in love with combat sports. He believed in me when others said I was too small or too skinny. He spoke to the winner in me before I even knew I was a winner, and I’ll forever be grateful for him introducing me to combat sports.

Who are 3 people you'd love to meet or work with? I’d love to meet Demetrious Johnson, Janay Harding, and Joe Rogan.

What are your hobbies, activities, or other interests when not training for a fight? I enjoy drinking beer, eating noodles, punching faces, playing video games, and hanging out with friends and family.
